disposition: Coordinator-approved supplemental source correction for distinct legacy-real-codex-podman profile; no root overlay write or wholesale source cherry-pick
source:
# AFT real-codex overlay for the containerized ModeCloud stack.
# The epic-runner's builtin local-task-runner inherits CODEX_HOME, so this
# overlay intentionally does not set LOOM_DRIVER_TASK_RUNNER_CMD_JSON.

services:
  fleet-db:
    environment:
      # The aft tier exercises the ModeCloud container topology + session
      # forensics over real containers/redis — NOT fleet-db's authz model.
      # The base stack enables full authz, which requires per-API-key
      # authorization grants (provisioned via setup.sh in the A1 flow) before
      # serve's domain calls succeed. Run fleet-db in dev-mode (trust X-Actor)
      # with authz off so the epic-runner flow works without that grant step,
      # matching the binary-only standalone recipe (--auth-dev-mode
      # --authz-enabled=false).
      FLEET_AUTH_DEV_MODE: "true"
      FLEET_AUTHZ_ENABLED: "false"
  loom-serve:
    environment:
      CODEX_HOME: /home/node/.codex-rw
      LOOM_STACK_CODEX_RW_DIR: /home/node/.codex-rw
      # The epic-runner is a BUILT-IN workflow whose registration resolves
      # @flue/runtime at trigger time; without this serve 500s with "local
      # @flue/runtime package not found". The image bakes flue at /opt/flue
      # (Containerfile.loom-serve). (The A1 review flow uses a different path,
      # so the base stack never sets this.) Mirrors the host tier's FLUE_REPO.
      FLUE_REPO: /opt/flue
      # Remove the base stack's empty generic-runner override. Epic-runner must
      # select the builtin local-task-runner so CODEX_HOME is re-admitted.
      LOOM_DRIVER_TASK_RUNNER_CMD_JSON: null
      LOOM_FLUE_AGENT_MODEL: ${LOOM_AFT_FLUE_AGENT_MODEL:-openai-codex/gpt-5.5}
      LOOM_FRONTEND_DIR: /opt/webui
      LOOM_FRONTEND_URL: http://localhost:${LOOM_STACK_SERVE_PORT:-18282}
    volumes:
      - ${LOOM_STACK_CODEX_HOST_DIR:?set to host ~/.codex}:/home/node/.codex:ro
      - ${LOOM_AFT_FRONTEND_DIST:?set to internal/webui/frontend/dist}:/opt/webui:ro
